cards.text: David is the new king over all Israel (1 Chronicles 11:3). Now we meet his mighty men, the chiefs who, together with all Israel, strengthened his kingdom, according to the word of the LORD. Friend, the most dangerous thing I face all day is a hot cookie sheet, and I STILL scream like it ambushed me.
First on the list is Jashobeam son of Hachmoni, chief of the officers. One man, one spear and a WHOLE lot of opponents.

cards.question: Jashobeam wields his spear against ___ hundred men and kills them at one time.

cards.text: Next in command is Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men, and he's with David at Pas-dammim when the Philistines gather for battle at a field full of barley. A field full of barley, friend, and it is NOT about to stay peaceful.

cards.question: When the Philistines come at the barley field at Pas-dammim, the troops hold their ground.
The troops flee the barley field at Pas-dammim. What do Eleazar and David do?

answers.text: Stand in the middle of the field and defend it
Chase after the troops to bring them back
Set fire to the barley and slip away

cards.question: Eleazar and David strike down the Philistines, and the ___ brings about a great victory.

cards.text: Three of the thirty chief men go down to David at the rock at the cave of Adullam, while a company of Philistines is camped in the Valley of Rephaim. Keep your eye on these three, friend.
David is in the stronghold. Then he longs for water, and he wishes out loud for a drink from one particular well.

cards.question: David wishes someone would bring him a drink of water. Where is the well he's thinking of?

cards.text: The Philistines have a garrison at Bethlehem, and the Three break right through the Philistine camp, draw water from that well, and carry it back to David. Friend, when I wish out loud in my bakery, the only thing that answers me is the oven timer.

cards.question: The Three hand David water they got by breaking through a Philistine camp. What does David do with it?

answers.text: He pours it out to the LORD
He gives it to the troops

cards.question: David refuses to drink the water from Bethlehem because the men risked their lives to bring it.

cards.text: Then David says, "Far be it from me, my God, to do this! How can I drink the blood of these men who risked their lives?" Such were the exploits of the three mighty men.

Now meet Abishai, the brother of Joab, and Joab is David's chief commander (1 Chronicles 11:6). Like Jashobeam, Abishai wields his spear against three hundred men, kills them, and wins a name along with the Three.

cards.question: Abishai, who wins a name along with the Three, is officially included among the Three.

cards.text: Abishai is doubly honored and leads the Three without ever being one of them. Next up is Benaiah son of Jehoiada from Kabzeel, a man of valor and a man of many exploits.

cards.question: Benaiah strikes down two champions. Which nation are they from?
On a snowy day, there's a lion down in a pit. What does Benaiah, the man of valor, do?

answers.text: He goes down into the pit and kills it
He covers the pit and leaves it there
He waits for it to climb out first

cards.text: Then there's an Egyptian, a huge man five cubits tall, holding a spear like a weaver's beam, and Benaiah goes against him with a club. A CLUB, friend, against THAT spear, and I'd have taken one look at it and dived face-first into the chocolate chips.

cards.question: Benaiah has a club. The huge Egyptian has a spear like a weaver's beam. How does Benaiah win?

answers.text: He snatches the spear and kills him with it
He knocks the spear away and the Egyptian runs
He calls the Three to fight beside him

cards.text: Those are the exploits of Benaiah son of Jehoiada. He wins a name along with the three mighty men, the same way Abishai did.

cards.question: Of all the Thirty, Benaiah is the most honored.
Benaiah never becomes one of the Three, but David appoints him over his ___.

cards.text: Then comes the long roll call of the mighty men, from Asahel the brother of Joab down to Jaasiel the Mezobaite, with names like Zelek the Ammonite, Ithmah the Moabite and Uriah the Hittite. Every one of them could beat me at arm wrestling, friend, and my arms are a MUSTACHE.
